- Banana, medium (about 118 g peeled): about 105 kcal, 1.3 g protein, 27 g carbs, 0.4 g fat.

- Carbs: 27 + 26 + 33 = 86, so about 85 g.
- Fat: 0.4 + 5 + 11 = 16.4, so about 16 g.
